mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.lot_id AS lotId, r.report_no AS reportNo, r.report_name AS reportName, r.inspection_date AS inspectionDate, r.inspection_org AS inspectionOrg, r.conclusion, r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.status, r.version, r.published_by AS publishedBy, r.published_at AS publishedAt, r.withdrawn_by AS withdrawnBy, r.withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_by AS updatedBy, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM xsy_trace_inspection_report r
mapper.select:
WHERE r.lot_id = #{lotId}
ORDER BY r.inspection_date DESC, r.id DESC

WHERE r.id = #{id}
FOR UPDATE OF r
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_inspection_report (lot_id, report_no, report_name, inspection_date, inspection_org, conclusion, expires_at, created_by, updated_by, operation_history) VALUES (#{lotId}, #{reportNo}, #{reportName}, #{inspectionDate}, #{inspectionOrg}, #{conclusion}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('action', 'CREATE', 'operator', CAST(#{createdBy} AS text), 'at', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_trace_inspection_report SET report_no = #{reportNo}, report_name = #{reportName}, inspection_date = #{inspectionDate}, inspection_org = #{inspectionOrg}, conclusion = #{conclusion}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1, operation_history = operation_history || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('action', 'SAVE', 'operator', CAST(#{updatedBy} AS text), 'at', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE xsy_trace_inspection_report SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{updatedBy}, published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1, operation_history = operation_history || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('action', 'PUBLISH', 'operator', CAST(#{updatedBy} AS text), 'at', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE xsy_trace_inspection_report SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_by = #{updatedBy}, withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1, operation_history = operation_history || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('action', 'WITHDRAW', 'operator', CAST(#{updatedBy} AS text), 'at', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND version = #{version}
